title: Slate pages have no heading at all (no h1/h2) [1.3.1 Info and Relationships]
expected: A page title heading (h1 such as "Slate") so screen-reader users can jump by heading and know where they are; sport/market context in the heading.
actual: Zero headings on /slate (every sport, Lines and Props). Edges, Alerts, Account, Results all have an h1. Landmarks exist (nav "Sport", nav "Market type") but main has no heading.
